verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents a public REST API. The docs cover secret `sk_` API-key authentication, an API v1 reference with server-side endpoints for refunds and promotional entitlements, and a `POST /receipts` import endpoint. An MCP server also lets AI assistants manage apps, Products and Entitlements without the dashboard. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes at the candidate paths returned 404), documented breadth of the configuration endpoints beyond the cited ones, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
